brief.en: Blows up all zombies in a huge area
brief.zh: 爆炸并对巨大范围内僵尸造成伤害

description.en: Doom Shrooms can blow up all zombies in a huge area. Leaving a crackled tile.
description.zh: 毁灭菇会爆炸并对范围内所有僵尸造成伤害，砸碎所在的格子，一段时间内无法种植植物。

chat.en: "Leave me far from what is valuable for you. How gentle I was to have told you that!"
chat.zh: “别让我离你珍视的东西太近了，把这件事告诉你，我真是太温柔了。”
